error_data.message: Sorry, your request timed out.  It's likely that your input was too large to process.  Consider building the tree incrementally, or building the commits you need in a local clone of the repository and then pushing them to GitHub.

recovery: Retry identical documents by pre-creating Git blobs and then creating a small reference-only tree. Canonical heartbeat and audit receipt remain unchanged.
